name: Pyromancer: Draconic Aspect active form is re-established at login for an existing talent owner (trikyn-live-ops#104)
contract: The hidden passive Draconic Aspect 92128 drives Pyromancer::Refresh to learn the active Draconic Aspect 802117. As with Knight of Xoroth's Brimstone, the passive's aura is not persisted across a save/load and the core does not re-cast hidden class passives at login, so an existing owner re-enters knowing passive 92128 with no aura 92128 and therefore no 802117. This confirms the single login re-establishment heals a second custom class, not only Xoroth: it reproduces that state, runs the login hooks, and requires 802117 to be re-learned. Client action-bar rendering is not observed.
